svg.title: Winning-Moment Stamp — 900 x 260 (BRAND-GUIDELINES.md §8.5 E)
svg.desc: Transparent overlay stamp. Centre horizontally at y=300 on a 1920x1080 canvas. Replace [RESULT] (the multiplier, e.g. 2.50x) and [CODE]. Set the two headline fills to #22c55e for a win or #ff4d6a for a loss. No mascot on this stamp — the result colour is the focus. Animation: 200ms scale 0.94 -> 1 with opacity 0 -> 1, hold 3.5s, 300ms fade.
